rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a Day 5 expanded 3AA blastocyst, including strong ICM/TE and thinning zona, but it adds fine visual details (exact clock-face position, minimal fragmentation, cytoplasmic granularity, absence of multinucleation) that may not be confidently verifiable from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, AMH, BMI, tubal factor diagnosis, endometrial thickness, first-cycle status, and partner factors with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, especially around morphology versus age-related aneuploidy, though the probability calculation is somewhat simplified and then adjusted upward without strong quantitative support.

Most recommendations are broadly evidence-based (eSET, counseling on age/aneuploidy, luteal support), but strong endorsement of PGT-A for all future cycles, ERA after one failed transfer, and embryo glue as a recommendation are more controversial and not uniformly guideline-supported.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and future planning, but some suggestions are more speculative than standard-of-care and would benefit from stronger prioritization.
